quotations.old_english: Hire fær is wiðmeten fyrdlícum truman
quotations.english: her course is compared to a martial band

source_text: fyrdlíc; adj. Military, martial; m&i-long;l&i-short;t&a-long;ris :-- Hire fær is wiðmeten fyrdlícum truman her course is compared to a martial band, Homl. Th. i. 444, 5: Jos. 11. 10.
